blocks.text: British singer-songwriter RAYE’s viral hit “WHERE IS MY HUSBAND!” has recently taken over the internet, specifically TikTok, as it perfectly captures the impatience, humor and occasional desperation of women waiting for their ideal partners. For the people obsessed with that song, “Wicker” starring Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård could be their next suitable watch as it explores that same longing only in a more entertaining, unconventional way. The film follows a lonely fisherwoman (Colman) who, tired of being ridiculed by her conservative seaside village for remaining unmarried, commissions a local basketmaker (Peter Dinklage) to make her a husband out of wicker.
